method: Seven-name, four-sector-plus-index book anchored by an 18% SPY ballast. The megacap-tech/AI cluster (NVDA 15% + AAPL 15% + GOOGL 10% = 40% of book) sits comfortably inside the 48% correlation cap, with GOOGL vol-scaled down to just 10% given its ~63%-of-price 52wk range versus AAPL/NVDA's tighter ~40% ranges (live quotes pulled fresh — the research snapshot's prices were stale by 9-12% across most names, notably JPM at $357.58 vs the survivor list's $336). JPM and V, the tightest-range, broadest multi-sleeve names, carry the largest active single-name slots (16%/15%) as low-vol quality compounders (V alone under the 20% payments cap); UNH is sized smallest (11%) for its softer composite and open DOJ/antitrust optionality, and NVDA's slot is deliberately held to 15% rather than maxed, sized for gap risk into its Aug 26 earnings print. Overall posture: moderate conviction, vol-aware, sector-diversified with no single non-index name above 16%. | risk-adjusted (finalize-target.mjs: correlation-cluster + vol-scaled caps)

names.thesis: Quality (9) + growth (9.5) sleeves lead the survivor set, but Aug 26 earnings sits inside the hold window and adversarial review flags China-export/circular-financing risk — sized for gap risk, not maxed on composite alone; vol now tight-ish (52wk range ≈40% of live price) after the run to $211.86.

Broadest multi-sleeve strength in the book — momentum (8), quality (8), growth (8) all align — at the tightest 52wk range (~22% of price); largest active slot as a low-vol compounder despite trading at an all-time high ($357.58) where valuation, not fundamentals, is the flagged risk.

Quality (9.5) is the standout sleeve with the tightest historical range (~20% of price) in the set — a low-vol payments compounder sized generously; sits well inside the 20% payments-cluster ceiling since it's the only payments name held (no MA).

Quality (9.5) + growth (8.5) rival V's, but by far the widest 52wk range (~63% of price) in the survivor set plus capex-driven margin compression and antitrust overhang — vol-scaled down to the smallest megacap-tech slot despite a composite on par with V/JPM.

Quality (9) + momentum (7) with the tightest range of the megacap-tech names near its 52wk high — sized alongside JPM/V for stability, tempered by guided gross-margin compression (memory costs, chip supply) into the holiday quarter.

Momentum (8.5) is the standout sleeve (strong technical recovery), but quality (6.5)/growth (5) are the softest in the book and the range is wide (~47% of price) — lowest composite here, further vol- and event-scaled down (open-ended DOJ criminal/antitrust probe) to the smallest active slot above the floor.
Uncapped index ballast diversifying away single-name and megacap-tech-cluster risk from an otherwise concentrated book; core hold with a wide, portfolio-level stop rather than a tactical exit.
